bio.text: Jim Rutledge is the Republican nominee for Maryland Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to his campaign website, he earned a Juris Doctor with honors from the University of Maryland School of Law.

His campaign website says he served on the Bel Air Town Board of Commissioners from 2023 to 2025 and on the Judicial Nominating Commission for District and Circuit Court judges in Harford County in 2022.
